[P2] Identify platform timeouts from structured error types

Searching the entire serialized error also matches application messages and stack traces. An ordinary failure mentioning a database timeout or a file named `timeout_helpers.py` becomes a `platform_timeout`, and the observed invocation outcome is overwritten with `TIMED_OUT`. This misclassifies failures and supplies incorrect deadline evidence. Inspect recognized platform timeout error types in the structured payload, applying the same rule in `Cloud.platform_timeout`. Test a non-platform error whose message or stack trace contains `timeout`.
